Pullups: Hang from the bar with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your palms facing forward.
Pull your shoulders down and drive your elbows down until your chin clears the bar.
Lower with control until your arms are almost straight.
If you cannot do them yet, use a resistance band or the assisted machine.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown: Sit in the machine with your thighs under the pads and grab the bar much wider than your shoulders.
With your chest up, pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze for a second and come up with control until your arms are straight.
Do not pull the bar behind your neck or lean back.
Full_Range-Of-Motion_Lat_Pulldown: Sit in the machine with your thighs secured and grab the bar shoulder-width apart.
At the top, let your shoulders rise to stretch your back fully.
Pull by first lowering your shoulders and then your elbows until the bar reaches your chest.
Return to the top with control, stretching fully.
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown: Attach a close-grip handle (V-handle or short bar) to the high pulley and sit with your thighs secured.
Pull towards your upper chest with your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze for a second and come up with control until your arms are straight.
Chin-Up: Hang from the bar with your palms facing you, shoulder-width apart.
Drive your elbows down until your chin clears the bar.
Lower with control until your arms are almost straight. It works the biceps a lot as well as the back.
Band_Assisted_Pull-Up: Hook a resistance band over the bar and rest one knee or foot in it.
Grab the bar slightly wider than your shoulders and pull until your chin clears it.
Lower with control. Use thinner bands as you get stronger.
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row: Standing with the bar in your hands, bend your knees slightly and lean your torso forward with a straight back, almost parallel to the floor.
Pull the bar to your lower chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second and lower with control until your arms are straight.
Do not jerk with your back: if you need it to lift the weight, reduce the load.
Seated_Cable_Rows: Sit in the machine with your feet on the footrests, knees slightly bent and the handle in your hands.
With a straight back, pull the handle to your stomach, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together for a second and return with control until your arms are straight, without rocking your torso back and forth.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row: With a dumbbell in each hand, bend your knees slightly and lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Row the dumbbells towards your hips, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lower with control.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row: Rest one knee and the hand on the same side on a bench, with your back straight and parallel to the floor.
With the other hand, row the dumbbell towards your hip, driving your elbow back and close to your body.
Lower with control until your arm is straight. Do all the reps and switch sides.
Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Row: With a kettlebell in each hand, bend your knees slightly and lean your torso forward with a straight back.
Row the kettlebells towards your hips, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lower with control.
Inverted_Row: Get under a bar at hip height (in the rack or a Smith machine) and grab it slightly wider than your shoulders.
With your body straight and your heels on the floor, pull until your chest touches the bar.
Lower with control. The more horizontal your body, the harder it is.
Barbell_Shrug: Stand with the bar in your hands in front of your thighs and your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears as high as you can, without bending your elbows.
Hold for a second and lower with control. Do not roll your shoulders.
Dumbbell_Shrug: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your shoulders towards your ears as high as you can.
Hold for a second and lower with control.
Kettlebell_Sumo_High_Pull: Take a wide stance with the kettlebell on the floor between your feet. Grab it with both hands.
With a straight back, stand up by extending your legs and hips and, at the end, pull the kettlebell to your chest with your elbows high.
Lower it with control along the same path.
Upright_Row_-_With_Bands: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the ends in front of your thighs.
Pull up with your elbows high until your hands reach chest height.
Lower with control. Do not go higher if your shoulders bother you.
Scapular_Pull-Up: Hang from the bar with your arms straight.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulders down away from your ears so your body rises a few centimetres.
Return to the hang with control. It helps prepare for pull-ups and look after your shoulders.
Barbell_Curl: Stand holding the bar shoulder-width apart with your palms facing forward.
With your elbows at your sides, bend them to curl the bar towards your shoulders.
Squeeze for a second and lower with control until your arms are straight. Do not swing.
Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing forward.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Squeeze for a second and lower with control.
EZ-Bar_Curl: Stand and grab the EZ bar on the angled grips, shoulder-width apart.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the bar towards your shoulders.
Lower with control. The angled grip is usually more comfortable for the wrists.
Standing_Biceps_Cable_Curl: Stand facing a low pulley with a short bar held with your palms up.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the bar towards your shoulders.
Squeeze for a second and lower with control. The cable keeps tension throughout the range.
Close-Grip_EZ-Bar_Curl_with_Band: Pass a band under your feet and hook it to the ends of an EZ bar. Grab it with your hands close together.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the bar towards your shoulders; the band adds resistance at the top.
Hammer_Curls: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing each other.
Without turning your wrists, curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders with your elbows at your sides.
Lower with control. It also works the forearm.
Cable_Hammer_Curls_-_Rope_Attachment: Attach a rope to the low pulley and grab it with your palms facing each other.
With your elbows at your sides, curl the rope towards your shoulders.
Alternate_Hammer_Curl: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl one dumbbell towards your shoulder without turning your wrist and lower it with control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Farmers_Walk: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand (dumbbells, kettlebells or farmer's handles), squatting down with a straight back.
Stand up and walk with short steps, chest up and shoulders back.
Cover the set distance or time and put the weights down with a straight back.
